name: card-fan-carousel
title: Card Fan Carousel
description: Image cards spread in a fan like a hand of playing cards. Springy entrance, hover lifts a card and pushes neighbours aside; with more than 7 cards, arrows/dots/arrow keys page through them.
darkMode: arrows and dots have dark: styles; cards are just photos
mainProps: cards: {imgUrl, alt?, linkUrl?}[], showControls, className, cardClassName
notes: Best with 5-12 cards. Section sizes itself (22rem mobile -> 38rem desktop). Card size: override with cardClassName (set h/w and matching negative -ml/-mt = half of each). Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
